annotations.title: Get an Etix event/performance by id

description: Fetch a single Etix event (performance) by its numeric event_id — name, date/time, venue (with address + coordinates), organizer, ticket price range and the individual priced offer levels. Get the event_id from etix_search. Read-only, no Etix account required.
name: etix_get_event
title: Get an Etix event/performance by id
